All 14 queries ran and gave plausible answers. I checked T12 and T13 by hand against the CSV, and T1 against the user list. I didn't re-check the others by hand.

Answers from the files here:
- T1: 4
- T3: US 3, DE 2, FR 2, unknown 2
- T4: 33.17
- T10: db 3, api 1, worker 1
- T11: 330.2
- T12: 204.91
- T13: Birch 109.97, then Acme 104.96
- T14: elderberry-banana-cherry-apple-date-kiwi-fig

T1: /data/users | filter ~(allOf /active (at :email | coalesce "" | lower | endsWith "@example.com")) | count
T2: /data/users | filter ~(/roles | any ~(lower | eq "admin")) | sort ~(/name | lower) * /name
T3: /data/users | groupBy ~(at :profile | coalesce {} | at :country | coalesce "unknown") * count
T4: /data/users * (at :profile | coalesce {} | at :age) | filter ~(ne null) | avg | round 2
T5: filter ~(/state | eq "open") * /labels | flat * (/name | lower) | distinct | sort
T6: sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 * {:number /number :assignee (at :assignee | coalesce {} | at :login)}
T7: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | filter ~(at :assignee | coalesce {} | at :login | ne null) | groupBy ~(/assignee/login) * count
T8: [/dependencies /devDependencies] | reduce {} ~(union) | entries | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") | sort ~(/0) * (:e / | (e | /0 | keyword) | append "@" | append (e | /1))
T9: /services | filter ~(allOf (at :enabled | eq true) (/port | gt 8000)) * (/name | lower) | sort | join ","
T10: lines * split " " | filter ~(/1 | eq "ERROR") | groupBy ~(/2) * count
T11: lines * split " " * (filter ~(startsWith "ms=")) | filter ~(count | gt 0) * (/0 | drop 3 | parseJson) | avg | round 1
T12: lines | drop 1 * split "," | filter ~(allOf (/5 | lower | eq "shipped") (/4 | ne "")) * mulOf (/3 | parseJson) (/4 | parseJson) | sum | round 2
T13: lines | drop 1 * split "," | filter ~(allOf (/5 | lower | ne "cancelled") (/4 | ne "")) | groupBy ~(/1) * (* mulOf (/3 | parseJson) (/4 | parseJson) | sum) | entries * {:customer (/0 | keyword) :total (/1 | round 2)} | sort ~((/total | desc)) | take 2
T14: ["Banana","apple","Cherry","banana","fig","APPLE","date","kiwi","Fig","elderberry"] * lower | distinct | sort ~([(count | desc) /]) | join "-"
